content_sections.heading: About RABL CARS Chhuikhadan
content_sections.text: Rani Avanti Bai Lodhi College of Agriculture and Research Station (RABL CARS) is a college of Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV), Raipur. It is in Chhuikhadan, in Khairagarh-Chhuikhadan-Gandai district of Chhattisgarh, and teaches B.Sc. Ag. (Hons.) courses. The Dean of the college issued this notice.

content_sections.heading: RABL CARS Guest Teacher Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 years. SC, ST, OBC and women candidates get 5 years of relaxation as per CG Government rules. Master's Degree in the relevant subject of Agriculture with 55% or equivalent grade 6.50 on a 10.0 scale, with a good academic record. Candidates with a Master's degree must also have passed NET (National Eligibility Test) for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor and equivalent, in the discipline in which NET is conducted. They also need one publication in a refereed journal related to NAAS (National Academy of Agricultural Sciences, New Delhi). Ph.D. holders do not need NET if the Ph.D. was done with course work as prescribed by the UGC Regulation 2009. They must also have at least two full-length publications with a NAAS rating of not less than 4 on the last date of submission of the application. A Ph.D. without course work does not qualify for the NET exemption. If no eligible candidate is available, the college may, in extreme cases of exigency, consider PG candidates as part-time teachers on a period basis. This would be for only one semester and needs approval from the competent authority. For the full eligibility conditions for the discipline, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview before a committee. The interview follows the university's 2019 guidelines and norms. The venue is the College of Agriculture, IGKV, Raipur (C.G.). Bring all your original documents for verification on the interview day. Candidates without them will not be allowed to appear. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. After the committee selects a candidate, the candidate must submit an affidavit on stamp paper of Rs. 50/- in the prescribed format, agreeing to the terms and conditions set by the Vishwavidyalaya.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is contractual. It lasts for one academic session or until a regular teacher is appointed, whichever comes first. The post is purely temporary. The selected candidate has no right to claim a regular appointment to any post advertised by IGKV, Raipur. Guest Teachers handle teaching, examinations, laboratory work, sports, cultural activities and any other work assigned from time to time. If performance is unsatisfactory, services can be ended with one week's notice. Anyone whose claimed credentials turn out to be false will be removed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RABL CARS Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form in the prescribed format. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Attach a self-attested photograph and copies of your certificates, experience documents and research papers. Send the application by registered post or speed post to: Dean, Rani Avanti Bai Lodhi College of Agriculture & Research Station, Chhuikhadan, KCG- 491885 (CG). You can also email it to [email protected] . Make sure it arrives by 5:00 pm on 10 November 2026. Go to the interview at the College of Agriculture, IGKV, Raipur, at 11:00 am on 20 November 2026, with all original documents.

faq.question: Q1. Which subject is the Guest Teacher needed for?
faq.answer: Agricultural Statistics. The teacher will take B.Sc. Ag. (Hons.) courses at the Chhuikhadan college.

faq.question: Q2. Is NET compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, for candidates with only a Master's degree, who also need one publication in a NAAS-related refereed journal. Ph.D. holders who did course work under the UGC Regulation 2009 and have two full-length publications with a NAAS rating of at least 4 do not need NET.

faq.question: Q3. What minimum marks are required in the Master's degree?
faq.answer: 55%, or an equivalent grade of 6.50 on a 10.0 scale, in the relevant subject of Agriculture, with a good academic record.

faq.question: Q4. How much will an M.Sc. holder without NET earn?
faq.answer: Rs. 1200/- per working day, up to Rs. 26,000/- a month. With NET, it rises to Rs. 1500/- per working day, up to Rs. 36,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there age relaxation for women candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. Women, SC, ST and OBC candidates get 5 years of relaxation over the 40-year limit, as per CG Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: At the College of Agriculture, IGKV, Raipur (C.G.), not at Chhuikhadan. It starts at 11:00 am on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: One academic session, or until a regular teacher is appointed, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel expenses be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What must the selected candidate submit after selection?
faq.answer: An affidavit on Rs. 50/- stamp paper in the prescribed format, agreeing to the Vishwavidyalaya's terms and conditions.
